column3: False positive: the numbers are SHA-1 constants in bundled hashing code, not timestamps
Informational: Dayrule is a single-page app
Intended: index.html and the manifest revalidate on every load (max-age=0, must-revalidate)
Intended: hashed assets are immutable for a year; index.html is not cached
Intended: public static files served from the Vercel CDN cache
Access-Control-Allow-Origin * is Vercel default on public static files; without credentials it exposes nothing not already public
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy not set yet; adding it changes how the workers load and is checked on preview first
